title: RelaySMS Technical Paper
abstract: A technical deep-dive into RelaySMS — a transport layer bridging SMS with online platforms. Covers architecture, encryption using Signal's Double Ratchet protocol, authentication, key exchange, bridges, and threat modeling.

title: RelaySMS Payload Specifications
abstract: A specification document for RelaySMS payload structures and message formatting. It describes how data is encoded and exchanged across the RelaySMS transport layer.
